notes.title: Patch 1.2.2
notes.content:
Changes:

 The Crypt is now available for all players, not only for those who have unlocked 100% progress.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.1
notes.content:
Changes:

 previous food can be selected using Shift+Tab

notes.title: Paupers 1.2: The Crypt is out!
notes.content:
The Crypt is finally here! Decorate your personal space and visit it anytime you want!

Other changes:

 items can be now selected using buttons 1-6
 prolonged collectibles decay timer
 ghosts won't attack player during ascend

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1
notes.content:
Changes:

 nerfed shop prices, let's be serious!

notes.title: Paupers 1.1 with Spectral Currency Exchange Office are out!
notes.content:
Finally! The Spectral Currency Exchange Office is here! Now you can obtain holy coins from ascending ghosts and spend them on shiny new glamorous perks. Get your SWAG now!

Collect them all to unlock the ultimate reward: THE CRYPT - your own cozy place in the cemetery! [Coming in Patch 1.2]

All of this, of course, comes with an achievements refresh! And the promised Pope character is here - check out his fashionable outfit!

Full changelog:

Features:

 Added spectral coins
 Added Spectral Currecny Exchange Office
 Added temporary invulnerability after taking damage
 Added skipping cinematics with LMB
 Added 10 unlockable perks
 Added two new playable characters
 Added 4 new achievements


Fixes:

 Fixed bug with ghost not being able to reach the circle beacuse of player blocking the way
 Fixed multiple misc issues with identification
